title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa

OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.

Qualificações

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

Como se candidatar

Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ******. ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia
ONIlearning Technology

title: Banco de Talentos (Gerente de Loja)
description:
A Nalin tem como compromisso encantar nossos clientes e proporcionar uma experiência única. Com atuação no varejo de moda do estado do Rio de Janeiro, oferecemos produtos de qualidade e preços acessíveis, sempre com foco no atendimento de excelência.

Se você é apaixonado pelo varejo, gosta de encantar os clientes e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que busca a excelência, junte-se a nós! Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos novos talentos para fazer parte dessa história de sucesso.

Venha crescer conosco e contribuir para a experiência única que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes!

Se você se identificou com a nossa empresa, VENHA FAZER DO NOSSO TIME !

  • Gestão e controle de todas as operações de Vendas e Produtos Financeiros da Loja;
  • Análise de indicadores e KPI’s da Loja;
  • Orientar e acompanhar os serviços de vendas conforme a política estabelecida para assegurar o eficiente atendimento aos clientes;
  • Acompanhar as atividades de loja na apresentação das mercadorias e procedimento de controle de estoque;
  • Participação dos processos de seleção, admissão, jornada, férias, rescisão e afins do time de loja;
  • Estratégia de mercado e concorrência;
  • Inventário de estoque, bem como acompanhamento de relatórios (recebimento de mercadorias, entrada e saída de notas fiscais);
  • Gerenciamento dos contratos de manutenção e negociação de espaços na loja;
  • Cumprimento das exigências fiscais, sanitárias, etc. dos órgãos públicos.
  • Escolaridade necessária: Ensino Superior Completo - Obrigatório;
  • Desejável vivência anterior em Varejo de Moda;
  • Conhecimento em KPIs de vendas;
  • Desejável vivência com liderança de pessoas;

Nossa trajetória

Nossa trajetória é marcada pela dedicação, compromisso com a qualidade e foco constante em proporcionar uma experiência única para nossos clientes e para nosso time. Estamos no mercado desde 1971, alcançando resultados de excelência e com o objetivo de atender às necessidades de diversas famílias. Ao longo dessa jornada, nos estabelecemos como uma referência no mercado, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de produtos com qualidade e preços acessíveis.

Ao longo dos anos, crescemos e nos expandimos, conquistando a confiança e a lealdade de nossos consumidores. Hoje, com mais de 40 lojas espalhadas pelo Rio de Janeiro e uma equipe de colaboradores comprometidos, tornamo-nos sinônimo de excelência no atendimento e de um ambiente acolhedor.

Nossa história também é marcada pela valorização de nosso time, com programas de reconhecimento e ações de integração que fortalecem o espírito de equipe e a cultura organizacional. Acreditamos que nosso sucesso é reflexo do trabalho árduo e do empenho de cada membro da equipe, que, juntos, compartilham os mesmos valores de comprometimento, igualdade e melhoria contínua.

Hoje, seguimos nos reinventando e nos adaptando às necessidades do mercado. Nossa missão permanece firme, guiando todos os passos da empresa rumo a novos desafios e conquistas.

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um time de mais de 12 mil pessoas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Formamos um ecossistema que se estende por todo o país e que ultrapassa fronteiras, integrando e conectando negócios. Sabemos que o crescimento acontece de gente para gente, e é isso que nos move.

Nosso jeito de ser:

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral: Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade: A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time: Você será responsável por desenvolver soluções que conectem e integrem os produtos do nosso ecossistema, centralizando serviços e dados essenciais. Seu foco será criar ferramentas que aprimorem a experiência de desenvolvimento e aumentem a produtividade dos nossos times de engenharia. Se você é apaixonado por otimizar fluxos de trabalho, criar soluções escaláveis e proporcionar uma experiência de desenvolvimento excepcional, essa oportunidade é para você!

Suas principais entregas:

  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas e componentes reutilizáveis em React, focadas na experiência da pessoa desenvolvedora;
  • Projeto e implementar pipelines de CI/CD que facilitem o trabalho de desenvolvedores e equipes de engenharia;
  • Otimizar a performance de aplicações front-end por meio de CDN e module bundlers;

  • Familiaridade com Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com CDN e técnicas de otimização de entrega de conteúdo;
  • Proficiência em module bundlers (Webpack, Rollup, Parcel).

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Experiência com micro front-ends;
  • Vivência em ambientes com arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (unitários e integração) voltados para a experiência da pessoa desenvolvedora;
  • Ser (ou querer se tornar) uma pessoa ativa na comunidade, que compartilha conhecimento dentro e fora da empresa através de eventos, artigos, mentorias, iniciativas voluntárias, projetos open source, etc.

Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade, descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. If you receive suspicious requests or communications, please report them All of our legitimate openings can be found on the Personify HealthCareer Site.

• Autonomia e colaboração para trabalhar de forma produtiva no modelo remoto

title: Senior React Native Developer (Ios Native Expertise)
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior React Native Developer with strong experience in native iOS app development. This role involves working directly with a U.S.-based client, contributing to the design and implementation of mobile solutions that solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate is passionate about mobile technologies, capable of architecting scalable applications, and thrives in collaborative environments.

Location

Location: Brazil

Job Mode

Full-time

Work Mode

Work from home

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and develop high-quality mobile applications using React Native and native iOS technologies (Swift / Objective-C);
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features;
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help shape the technical direction of mobile solutions;
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and other technical issues;
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications;
  • Communicate effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders to understand requirements and provide technical guidance;
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to code reviews and best practices.

Essential Skills

  • Experience in mobile development, with React Native;
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently;
  • Strong proficiency in native iOS development (Swift and / or Objective-C);
  • Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns (MVC, MVVM, Clean Architecture);
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, third-party libraries, and integration tools;
  • Experience collaborating with product teams and anticipating technical challenges;
  • Strong coding and testing practices;
  • Familiarity with CI / CD pipelines and mobile testing frameworks;
  • Exposure to Agile methodologies and tools (JIRA, Confluence);
  • Understanding of App Store deployment and release processes;
  • Fluent in English, with strong communication skills for client interaction.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Android development is a plus;
  • Experience with WordPress;
  • Knowledge of cloud services (e.g., AWS, Firebase).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
Descrição da atividade

  • Cumprir e promover normas e procedimentos de segurança, meio ambiente, saúde ocupacional e compliance, bem como instruções de trabalho, zelando pela segurança e bem estar individual e coletiva;
  • Realizar atividades no Sistema de Gerenciamento de Manutenção (SAP PM) - Ex.: Criar Ordens de Manutenção, Vizualizar e Realizar a programação de ordens, Atribuir Status de Sistema as Ordens (ENTE, ENCE, LIB e etc.), Retirar relatórios de Serviços de Manutenção e etc..;
  • Programar Ordens de Manutenção na Rotina de Manutenção;
  • Programar, Solicitar e Controlar a utilização dos recursos de manutenção (Andaimes, Mão de Obra, Equipamentos e etc.);
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades programadas junto a equipe de Execução e acompanhar a apropriação de parametros de realização no SAP;
  • Providenciar a disponibilidade das peças/materiais de acordo com as solicitações de reservas para as manutenções programadas;
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades de armazenagem e solicitações de materiais para ordens de manutenção;
  • Comunicar resultados que envolvam a programação de Ordens de Manutenção (Desenvolver e divulgar relatórios, participar de reuniões e etc.);
  • Balancear a utilização dos recursos de manutenção (Andaimes, Mão de Obra, Equipamentos e etc.) dentro da programação de Ordens de Manutenção;
  • Controlar e analisar indicadores de manutenção que envolvam a programação de Ordens de Manutenção (Ex.: Back Log, Índice de Execução e etc.);
  • Controlar o Back Log das Ordens de Manutenção (Serviços não Executados) visando maximizar a utilização de recursos de execução na programação;
  • Organizar e/ou participar de visitas técnicas relativas as atividades a serem executadas na Programação de Ordens de Manutenção;
  • Apoiar a Engenharia de Manutenção e/ou a Inspeção / Manutenção em atividades que envolvam Planejamento de Manutenção (Detalhamento de Escopo, determinação de recursos, geração de pontos de melhoria, analise de falhas e etc.);
  • Programar Ordens de Manutenção na Parada de Manutenção;
  • Preparar e liderar reuniões de cronograma e avaliação de Paradas de Manutenção;
  • Desenvolver Planejamento de grandes paradas de manutenção (PGP) em sua área de atuação, atendendo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos planejadores em sua área de atuação, em todo o processo de planejamento de manutenção de rotina, preventiva e Grandes paradas.
  • Contribuir para prática de atividades de metodologia 5s que envolve: Utilização, Arrumação, Limpeza, Padronização e Disciplina no ambiente de trabalho.

Pré-requisitos

  • Formação técnica em mecânica e/ou cursos correlacionados concluídos.
  • CFT Ativo.
  • Experiência nas atividades descritas.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de turno.
  • Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro - RJ

* Lembramos que a Ternium é uma empresa que se preocupa com a inclusão, por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas à Pessoas com Deficiência e Reabilitados pelo INSS.

Overview

Are you passionate about identity and access management (IAM) and ready to make a meaningful impact? HealthEquity is seeking an IAM Application Onboarding Lead to help mature and scale our access administration practices. In this role, you’ll be a key contributor to our IAM Program—driving process improvements, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring secure, compliant access across our environment. You’ll collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to onboard applications, enhance procedures, and promote a security-first mindset. Your work will help build a strong understanding of IAM’s value and benefits across the organization. We’re looking for someone who, thrives in cross-functional environments, is proactive and detail-oriented, stays current with the latest security practices, communicates clearly and confidently and is excited to shape the future of IAM at HealthEquity. If you're ready to lead with purpose and help us safeguard access in a dynamic, growing organization—this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the intake and centralization of access administration for all internal HealthEquity applications, ensuring compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with application owners, technical teams, and Application Administrators to gather requirements, onboard applications to IAM, and recommend compliance controls.
  • Drive role-based access assessments, implement and automate RBAC processes, and help maintain IAM policies, standards, and guidelines.
  • Utilize SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and Excel for data analysis and access management; PowerShell scripting is a plus for integration and automation.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, audit/compliance, and the User Access Certification & Governance team to ensure secure, compliant access and provide audit evidence when needed.
  • Act as a liaison among stakeholders to review, document, and communicate system activities, ensuring access assignments align with industry regulations, IAM principles, and a security-first mindset.
  • Integrate new applications with the IAM platform for provisioning and deprovisioning, and support execution of the IAM roadmap.
  • Provide IAM process guidance and requirements, create IAM solutions and roles for application onboarding, and develop process documentation for centralized access administration.
  • Facilitate collaboration and lead cross-functional teams and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) phases for defect fixes, enhancements, and critical initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, processes, and tools such as SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, NERM, and OneTrust.
  • Experience onboarding applications to IAM, conducting technical assessments, and implementing role-based access controls.
  • Familiarity with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, audit requirements, and User Access Certification & Governance practices.
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and access management; PowerShell scripting for integration and data import tasks.
  • Proficient in on-prem Active Directory and Entra ID.
  • Strong ability to gather requirements, recommend controls, and collaborate with application owners and technical teams.
  • Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and procedural irregularities; able to collect data, draw conclusions, and align resolution responsibilities.

VEM SER GUARACAMP !

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marcaraiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos oGuaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco no resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.Aqui,buscamos gente boa para formar um time forte , com atitude de dono, espírito de realização e sede por evolução. Valorizamos quem acredita quetudo pode ser feito melhor , comtransparência, disciplina e vontade de fazer acontecer . Se você se identifica com esses princípios e querdeixar sua marca no mundo , seu lugar é com a gente!

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: O Gerente Geral Comercial será responsável por liderar e gerenciar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, incluindo vendas internas, externas, revendas e parcerias. Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. O profissional deverá ter uma visão estratégica, orientada para a análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de novos canais e parcerias, e promover a evolução contínua das equipes sob sua gestão.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Gestão dos Canais de Vendas: Supervisionar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, garantindo que as metas de vendas sejam alcançadas em cada segmento (interno, externo, revendas, etc.).
• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.
• Acompanhamento de Indicadores: Analisar e acompanhar semanalmente os relatórios de vendas, desempenho e KPIs, fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.
• Desenvolvimento de Novas Parcerias: Identificar novas oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a rede de canais de vendas e ampliar a capilaridade do mercado.
• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.
• Suporte a Gerentes e Supervisores: Oferecer suporte contínuo aos gerentes de unidades e supervisores, fornecendo orientações, ferramentas e recursos necessários para o atingimento das metas comerciais.
• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.

REQUISITOS:

1. Ensino Superior Completo. Desejável Pós Graduação ou MBA na área
2. Atuação anterior em gestão na área comercial com entendimento de todos os canais (direto e indireto)
3. Pacote Office avançado
4. CNH tipo B

HABILIDADES:

1. Visão de Mercado
2. Liderança
3. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade
4. Orientação para Resultados

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA
description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Salary - Annually: Step I - 101,540.00 USD

Post Adjustment - Annually: 30,563.54 USD

Contractual Agreement: Staff - Professional Post

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Disclaimer & Application Details

  • This vacancy notice may be used to fill other similar positions at the same grade and level.

  • All applicants are required to complete an online profile to be considered for this post.

  • Candidates will be contacted only if they are under serious consideration.

  • If selected for interview, provide scanned copies of required degrees/certificates. PAHO considers official qualifications from accredited institutions as recognized by WHED/IAU/UNESCO, CHEA, and NCES.

  • Assessment of credentials can be performed via listed sources: World Higher Education Database (WHED), Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and College Navigator (NCES).

  • Links (plain text): whed.net, chea.org, nces.gov.

  • Any appointment/extension is subject to PAHO Staff Regulations, Staff Rules and e-Manual.

PAHO/WHO is committed to:

  • Persons with disabilities can request reasonable accommodations to participate in recruitment; contact

  • Maintaining high standards of integrity and accountability in professional and personal activities.

  • Promoting a work environment free from harassment, discrimination, and abusive behavior. Background checks will be conducted.

Join to apply for the Backend Software Engineer (Node, Python, Ruby on Rails or Go!) role at Black & White Zebra.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating in the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products.

You can work remotely or in a flexible regime if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Keep in mind that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Technology Director, working in the BWZ Labs Team but also closely with the Web Platform. You will be tasked with the development of internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer-facing systems used by thousands of clients.

You don’t have to know all the answers, because you will have time to research and learn new technologies and solutions, so you can make suggestions and implementations that might fit our product needs to better perform and scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a software engineer with meaningful experience building web applications
  • You are good at curating your own priorities
  • You are curious about how things are done and how they work
  • You are good at communicating your deliveries and demands with peers and stakeholders
  • You don’t like repetitive tasks, so you automate everything you can
  • You like to test new things, and you don’t mind if it doesn\'t work and move on

How Your Success Will Be Measured

  • We don’t like to measure effort, rather we focus on effectiveness
  • You will be accountable for your results, not the hours you worked
  • You will be part of a team; collaboration is a key factor

Your Skill Set Includes

  • Curiosity to understand how things work
  • An unbridled openness to learning new technology
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills
  • Openness to learn and use new programming languages
  • You are comfortable reading/writing documentation for others
  • Good communication in English

Required Experience for this Position

  • Meaningful experience building web applications using high-level programming languages such as PHP, Python, Ruby, GoLang, or similar
  • Track record of contributing to end-to-end system development, covering UI, server-side logic, and infrastructure layers
  • Experience with system design of web applications
  • Experience with Javascript technologies such as React, Node.js, Next.js, or similar
  • Solid understanding of databases and how they work
  • Good understanding of Cloud Infrastructure and how they work

Nice to Haves for this Position

  • Experience with AWS-based architecture
  • Experience with Cloudflare platform
  • Experience working with CMS (WordPress or similar)
  • Experience using AI IDEs
  • Experience building LLM-based applications/workflows
  • Experience with MVC frameworks
  • Experience developing APIs and/or MCPs
  • Experience writing tests and building deployment pipelines

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work. Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally.

We got our start in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. Since then, we’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 14 online publications. We enjoy an impact-driven environment that combines the agility of a startup with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company.

We’ve recently ranked #30 in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Company list and received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication for The Digital Project Manager—and we’re listed in both Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers and Best Employers in BC. All of this growth is driven by our commitment to our mission: In a world of evolving skills, practices, and technology, we’re creating a playbook for the future of work and empowering communities to create it with us.

Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Naval - Casco Externo


Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee


Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!


Garantir a integridade naval por meio do planejamento e execução de inspeções e reparos baseados em risco, gestão de UWILD, amarras, mangotes e hawser, interação com Classe/Bandeira, assegurando conformidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.


Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento e a colaboração dos colegas de trabalho e da equipe. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.



  • Planejar e executar o programa de integridade naval , priorizando por risco (RBI), analisando relatórios de classe, UWILD, mooring, definindo escopos e workpacks de inspeção e reparo; manter dashboard e registro de anomalias.

  • Conduzir campanhas UWILD , preparando escopo, selecionando métodos (GVI/CVI por ROV, END focal e leituras de CP), minimizando mergulho, para cumprir requisitos e evidências de Classe para UWILD.

  • Gerir mangotes de offloading e hawser , implementando rotina de inspeção, recertificação, critérios de aceitação e descarte, controle de sobressalentes e definir planos de execução

  • Assegurar integridade de amarras do sistema de ancoragem , aplicando gestão de integridade ao longo do ciclo de vida, incluindo inspeção, avaliação de desgaste e tensão, plano de substituição.

  • Interagir com Classe/Bandeira , atendendo inspeções, respondendo findings, comprovando correções e mantendo dossiês técnicos para auditorias e vistorias.

  • Coordenar SIMOPS e logística de inspeções , planejando janelas, alinhando AHTS/apoio, e privilegiar soluções “no dive” sempre que possível.

  • Padronizar normas e procedimentos internos , redigindo e atualizando procedimentos para casco, amarras e offloading; treinar equipes e garantir aderência

  • Gerir terceiros e QA/QC , qualificando fornecedores, conduzindo kick offs, supervisionando execução, validando relatórios com evidências e KPIs e promovendo a execução com total segurança

  • Documentar e medir desempenho , mantendo o SAP e repositório técnico atualizados com planos, certificados, relatórios, e registros de anomalias; reportar KPIs de integridade e conformidade.



Formação Acadêmica:



  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Naval, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Gestão de Ativos, Projetos ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.



Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos:



  • Sólido conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis à integridade de ativos offshore, API, ASME, DNV, ABS e normas da Marinha do Brasil.

  • Domínio de metodologias de inspeção baseadas em risco (RBI), análise de falhas (RCFA), gestão de anomalias e planos de inspeção e teste (ITP).



Ferramentas e Sistemas:



  • Experiência avançada com SAP PM para gestão de manutenção e inspeções, ferramentas de análise de dados como Excel avançado e Power BI, além de softwares de engenharia e modelagem estrutural (ex: AutoPIPE, ANSYS, OrcaFlex). Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera) e sistemas de controle de MOCs e não conformidades.



Certificações e Treinamentos Regulatórios:



  • Treinamentos obrigatórios para atuação offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-10, NR-35, entre outros) devem estar atualizados conforme exigência legal.

  • Inglês avançado para leitura e fala, interpretação de normas técnicas internacionais, elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com entidades certificadoras e fornecedores.



Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?


Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!


Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!


Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.


Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!



Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:


-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;


-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.


Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.


Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

You will lead and collaborate closely with the engineering team, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and ensuring the team is aligned and effective. You will also work closely with Product and Design to drive the platform forward.

  • Design and implement APIs, and integrate with third-party services

Qualifications

  • Skills: Proficient in code review, system architecture, and software best practices
  • Proficiency in backend languages and frontend frameworks
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, leadership and collaboration skills
  • High level of Spanish and English
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Familiarity with Generative AI (Chat GPT, Prompting, APIs, Fine-tuning) and Machine Learning algorithms (Python)

Personal Attributes:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive and adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Commitment to social mission and inclusive education

Education and Experience (minimums):

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with full-stack development
  • Strong experience in DevOps / cloud infrastructure (AWS, CI / CD pipelines)
  • Experience in projects using PHP (Laravel), React.JS, Next.JS
  • Knowledge of data security and regulatory compliance (GDPR, FERPA, or other relevant frameworks)
  • Experience with databases (eg. MySQL, MariaDB, Supabase, MongoDB), caching, and API design
  • Experience integrating AI / ML models into production applications
  • Experience leading distributed or remote teams

Qualified candidates may apply on or before October 3, 2025, to with a cover letter and resume. Please include position title in subject line of email.   • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and contribute to scalability of our rapid growth.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and Salesforce features to recommend enhancements and optimizations.
  • Provide training to development teams and end-users on Salesforce applications.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience with Salesforce in an Architect or Senior Developer role.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Platform.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Strong experience with Salesforce integrations (APIs, web services, middleware).
  • Expertise in data modeling, data migration, and data integration.
  • Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g., Technical Architect, Application Architect).
  • Experience in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
  • Experience leading large-scale Salesforce implementations and managing teams.
  • Advanced English level required to work with US clients and effectively communicate solutions.

  • Sign up: Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review: Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact: Our team will contact you to arrange an interview and share more about what we are looking for.

  • Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.

title: Remote Physics Research Scientist (Phd, Ai Reasoning) - 34878
description:
Overview

Turing is hiring Physics Research Scientists (PhD, Remote) to test and improve how advanced AI models handle reasoning and problem-solving in physics. Work with top AI labs, contribute to frontier benchmarks, and earn $50–$150 / hr on a flexible, remote schedule.

Role Overview

We are seeking PhD-level Physics researchers to rigorously test the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). In this role, you’ll create physics problems, analyze model responses, and identify logical gaps to help improve AI’s conceptual understanding and structured problem-solving.

This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30).

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and evaluate challenging physics problems to test AI reasoning.
  • Analyze AI-generated solutions for logic, rigor, and step-by-step clarity.
  • Provide detailed, constructive feedback that highlights gaps in reasoning.
  • Contribute to the development of benchmarks that measure model performance on abstract and multi-step tasks.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine methodologies for testing AI reasoning.

Must-have Qualifications

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or related fields.
  • Strong ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with structured reasoning.
  • Skilled communicator, able to explain logic and critique clearly in writing.
  • Independent, self-motivated, and comfortable in a remote setting.
  • Reliable computer and internet setup.

Why Join Turing?

  • Impact : Help define how AI models reason about abstract, scientific problems.
  • Prestige : Work with leading AI labs shaping the future of reasoning systems.
  • Flexibility : Remote-first, with weekly hour options.
  • Career Growth : Gain experience at the intersection of AI and physics research.

Contract & Selection Process

  • Compensation : $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration : 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours : Up to 30 hrs / week.
  • Time Zone : 2–5 hrs / day overlap with UTC-8 (America / Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Llm / Ai-Enabled Systems

About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid, disconnected software modules, our assistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural, empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience for every patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely and reliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empathetic experience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfully incorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at the frontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronous communication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack TypeScript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture is service oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant services and applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention to safety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for other engineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring, automated testing, CI / CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for our products, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards and architectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled product experiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications, databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining production applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript / Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significant impact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it through automated testing, CI / CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g., measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).

About the project

At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

Role: Salesforce Technical Lead

As a Salesforce Technical Lead, you will combine technical expertise, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to guide the successful implementation and ongoing optimization of Salesforce solutions, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.

How your day-to-day work will look like

  • Translating business requirements into well-architected solutions.
  • Leading technical design sessions with clients.
  • Developing custom solutions and integrations.
  • Managing technical scope and client expectations.
  • Evaluating system and architectural constraints as well as performance implications.
  • Designing and managing the execution of test plans to ensure a quality solution is delivered.
  • Code Development : Write and review code, develop custom functionalities, and integrate third-party applications using programming languages such as Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components.
  • Provide mentorship to customers and internal development teams, sharing insights on best practices, coding standards, and the capabilities of the Salesforce platform (including both "point-and-click" configuration and code customization).
  • Identify and troubleshoot technical challenges, addressing issues related to data integration, performance, security, and more.
  • Collaborate with project managers to define project scope, estimate efforts, and create implementation plans to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Business Analysts, Administrators, QA, and other Developers, to ensure seamless communication and alignment between technical and business needs.
  • Utilize strong customer-facing skills to support pre-sales processes.
  • Manage and lead platform upgrades and updates, staying current with Salesforce releases and assessing their impact on existing implementations.
  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, architectural diagrams, and coding guidelines. Contribute regularly to support the scalability of our rapid growth.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and Salesforce features to recommend enhancements and optimizations to existing implementations.
  • Provide training to development teams and end-users, ensuring they are well-equipped to effectively use and maintain Salesforce applications.

Ideal candidate

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ Years of experience working with Salesforce in an Architect or Senior Developer role.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Platform.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce Lightning, APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Strong experience with Salesforce integrations (APIs, web services, middleware).
  • Expertise in data modeling, data migration, and data integration.
  • Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g., Technical Architect, Application Architect).
  • Experience in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
  • Experience leading large-scale Salesforce implementations and managing teams.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our Talent Connection process

  • Sign up: Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review: Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact: Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
  • Knowing you better: We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • Notification: When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
  • Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.

Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely and reliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empathetic experience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfully incorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at the frontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronous communication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture is service oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

  • Proficiency with Javascript / Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), and PostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC, GraphQL).
