Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Key Obsessions (What are you obsessed with?)

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Compensation set based on agreed hours / scope of part-time role (flexible). Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.

  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and strategic restraint.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; strong references at your fingertips.
  • Bold when needed, able to defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, and easy to work with. Low-ego and crisp communicator.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor (power user); Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results. Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks. Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, landing pages, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. We move fast.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page.

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)
description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to a full-time role within 12 months based on impact. Remote-first; worldwide applicants welcome. Compensation set based on agreed hours/work scope of part-time role (flexible). Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity

We’re building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to:
    • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
    • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
    • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
    • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
    • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
    • Collaborate on campaigns end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
    • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI/SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batches.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns—and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, and edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you have references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include in Your Application

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, landing pages, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond. We move fast. For more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page. We really can’t wait to hear from you!

Overview

Área: Qualidade de Software. A área é peça-chave na entrega de produtos robustos, confiáveis e com altíssima performance. A missão é apoiar todas as tribos e squads no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, promovendo uma experiência fluida e segura para usuários finais ou stakeholders internos.

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Responsibilities

  • Promover excelência nas entregas de software por meio da definição, padronização e evolução contínua de processos e ferramentas de QA;
  • Atuar como liderança técnica em estratégias de testes, automação, observabilidade de qualidade, testes de performance e validação de sistemas críticos;
  • Desenvolver serviços e ferramentas dedicados ao processo de Qualidade de Software;
  • Conduzir PoCs com agentes de IA e ferramentas emergentes, explorando sua aplicação em tarefas de QA e validação inteligente;
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, projetos de engenharia da qualidade e integração com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Fomentar uma cultura sólida de qualidade por meio de treinamentos, mentorias técnicas e evangelização de boas práticas junto aos times de engenharia.

Atividades que você vai protagonizar

  • Conduzir discoveries técnicos, benchmarks e provas de conceito (PoCs) voltadas à evolução das práticas, ferramentas e soluções inteligentes para QA;
  • Traduzir iniciativas e ferramentas para desdobramento aos demais QAs;
  • Apoio direto no desdobramento e acompanhamento de indicadores do time de QA;

  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de estratégias de testes, cobertura, qualidade de código e gates em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Construir e manter pipelines de testes integradas ao processo de entrega contínua (CI/CD);

  • Analisar funcionalidades e riscos técnicos para elaboração de planos de testes eficazes, cobrindo múltiplos níveis de validação;
  • Atuar com times de engenharia em processos de troubleshooting e debugging, com foco na rastreabilidade e mitigação de falhas.

  • Capacidade de executar e interpretar testes de performance (stress, carga, pico), com domínio de ferramentas como JMeter, K6 e soluções em nuvem (IaaS);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como NewRelic, Grafana, CloudWatch (AWS);

  • Experiência sólida em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com atuação ativa em cerimônias e entregas iterativas;

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

title: Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Overview

Here at Shippo, we are the shipping layer of the internet and we consider ourselves to be one of the core building blocks of e-commerce. Our mission is to make merchants successful through world class shipping. With our products and solutions, we level the playing field by providing our customers with best-in-class solutions that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them. Through Shippo, e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, platforms and a variety of logistics infrastructure providers are able to connect to shipping carriers around the world from one API and dashboard. We provide our customers with the most competitive shipping rates, print labels, automated international documents, shipment tracking, facilitate the returns process and more.

We’re hiring an Analyst, Business Operations (L3) to be a high-energy generalist who thrives in spreadsheets, turns messy data into clear insights, and helps operationalize projects that move revenue and customer outcomes. You’ll start by supporting high-priority carrier operations work (e.g., data pulls, analyses to reduce billing variances), then expand into strategic analyses and GTM process improvements, especially within our platform partner ecosystem. This is an excellent role for an early-career analyst who loves data, is curious, communicates clearly, and wants broad cross-functional exposure.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

  • First 90 days: get in, get oriented, ship value
  • Own fast, accurate Google Sheets analyses and reports for carrier ops asks (think: data pulls, pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, basic modeling).
  • Partner with Carrier Ops, Partnerships, Finance, and Data to triage and quantify billing variances; share your findings
  • Document your work (inputs, queries/logic, outputs) and keep stakeholders updated with crisp async comms.
  • Start learning to read SQL queries/Databricks notebooks (no pressure to write complex SQL yet).
  • Months 3–12: broaden scope, own problems
  • Drive structured analyses to support our XMS strategy (e.g., partner pipeline sizing, revenue/label volume opportunity, cohort and conversion, playbook experiments).
  • Build lightweight dashboards/trackers (Sheets/Looker) that the team can trust and reuse.
  • Help operationalize GTM projects: draft SOPs/playbooks/templates, coordinate cross-functional tasks, and close the loop with clear follow-ups.
  • Propose small process improvements that remove toil, tighten data hygiene, or improve reporting quality.

Do you tick the boxes?

  • Must haves:
  • 1 - 3 years in an analytical role (consulting, biz ops, finance/FP&A, rev ops, product analytics, or similar).
  • Google Sheets power user: pivots, lookups, array formulas, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, filters, cleaning/joining, fast navigation.
  • Evidence of basic financial/analytical modeling and business case writing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: you ask clarifying questions, state assumptions, and keep partners in the loop. You’re not afraid to ask the ‘dumb questions’
  • Comfortable context switching and working cross-functionally in a remote environment.
  • Nice-to-haves:
  • SQL comfort (reading/editing simple SELECT/JOIN/WHERE) and curiosity to learn more; exposure to Databricks/Looker helpful.
  • Experience building simple GTM SOPs/playbooks or standing up lightweight reporting.
  • E-commerce/logistics familiarity is optional - no prior carrier background required.

What's in the Shippo package?

  • Medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage for you and your dependents. Pets coverage is also available!
  • Flexible policy for PTO and work arrangement
  • Two 1-week company shutdowns to rest and recharge (summer and winter)
  • 3 VTO days for ShippoCares volunteering events
  • Charity donation match up to $100
  • Fun team events outside of work hours - happy hours, “escape room” adventures, hikes, and more!

Sail through the process

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Remote.com (all Shippo perks still apply - including equity!). What we want to emphasize is that you can be successful at Shippo regardless of location.

We leverage AI to review all resumes during the application phase to ensure fairness, comprehensively evaluate each submission, and mitigate bias. However, all decisions at every stage of the process are made by a real person.

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to a full-time role within 12 months based on impact. Reports to Founder/Head of Design. Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

Overview

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaigns end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI/SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you’ll have references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).
  • Bonus Points if you have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal → your role → outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond. If you’re serious, feel free to include the optional Loom—personality matters.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page.

title: Influencer Marketing Lead (remote, ft-contract)
description:
Overview

TripleTen is a remote-first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment. We empower individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

We are seeking an experienced Influence Marketing Lead to spearhead our influencer marketing initiatives with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes in the USA market. The ideal candidate will drive lead generation and conversion through various influence channels, with emphasis on performance marketing metrics and efficient vendor management.

Please note that after applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment.

What you will do

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive performance-driven influencer marketing strategy across multiple markets, with a primary focus on the US market
  • Manage and coordinate multiple agencies, contractors, and vendors to ensure aligned execution of marketing initiatives
  • Build and nurture relationships with influencers across different tiers - from micro to macro influencers
  • Oversee agency relationships and deliverables, ensuring quality and adherence to KPIs
  • Manage campaign budgets with strict adherence to key performance metrics (CPL, CAC, ROAS)
  • Design and implement A/B tests to optimize campaign performance

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in influence marketing with proven track record in lead generation and sales conversion
  • Experience leading small teams and managing relationships with marketing agencies, freelancers, and contractors
  • Proven ability to negotiate and manage vendor contracts and service level agreements
  • Demonstrated success in the US market or other international markets
  • Deep understanding of performance marketing metrics and experience in campaign optimization
  • Experience in budget allocation and management across multiple vendors and channels
  • Hands-on experience working with major social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) and various content formats
  • Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal)

What we can offer you

  • Remote, Full-time Contract position
  • Level of freedom to determine the vision of projects and resources to achieve it. We don\'t believe in micromanaging
  • Get hands-on experience in an ed-tech environment (learning tools and the ins and outs of online education for adults)
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Slack, Miro, Notion to support teamwork
  • Diverse and close-knit team. We\'re spread out across the US, Europe, LATAM and more

Disclosures

  • At this time we are unable to offer H1B sponsorship opportunities in the USA.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista de Planejamento e Performance
description:
Grupo QuintoAndar | Analista de Planejamento e Performance

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções, em diferentes países da América Latina, que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar e ainda um Hub de Tecnologia em Portugal. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo. Com o apoio de uma equipe de classe mundial de investidores e consultores, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic e SoftBank, o Grupo QuintoAndar está atualmente avaliado em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões e continua a crescer ano após ano. Aqui você trabalhará com os melhores profissionais do mercado, em um ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alto desempenho. Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse

Localização & Trabalho Remoto

Nossa equipe de tecnologia trabalha no modelo "remote-first", o que significa que estamos trabalhando de casa com a possibilidade de morar em qualquer lugar do Brasil. Também temos a opção de utilizar os escritórios em São Paulo ou espaços de coworking de parceiros, até duas vezes por semana.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Aplicação
  • Entrevista com People
  • Entrevista com Hiring Manager
  • Case
  • Entrevista com Stakeholder 1
  • Entrevista com Stakeholder 2
  • Offer

Sobre a Área

Essa área é focada em transformar números em ações estratégicas. Somos responsáveis por analisar, criar e reportar dados que impulsionam a performance e a eficiência operacional. Aqui, você terá o desafio de transformar dados em insights, impactando diretamente a tomada de decisões e a otimização de processos em toda a organização.

Principais Atividades

  • Geração de Insights: Transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights claros e acionáveis, identificando tendências, gargalos e padrões para propor melhorias operacionais.
  • Criação de Dashboards e Relatórios: Criar e manter dashboards interativos e painéis de controle de KPIs, construindo análises detalhadas para embasar decisões estratégicas.
  • Preparação de Dados: Limpar e estruturar dados de diversas fontes, além de automatizar processos para garantir precisão e consistência.
  • Comunicação de Insights: Comunicar descobertas e recomendações de forma clara e estruturada para diferentes públicos, incluindo a alta liderança.
  • Governança de Dados: Garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados em colaboração com as áreas de Data e Produtos.
  • Análises Exploratórias: Desenvolver análises exploratórias de forma independente, buscando soluções inovadoras para desafios operacionais.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com análise de dados e performance operacional
  • SQL: Proficiência para análise de dados
  • BI: Domínio de ferramentas como Looker, Power BI, Superset, Tableau ou equivalentes
  • Excel/Google Sheets: Nível avançado
  • ETL: Manipulação e tratamento de dados, incluindo processos de ETL
  • Python (diferencial): Conhecimentos são um plus
  • Inglês (diferencial): Nível intermediário/avançado

Benefícios

  • Salário competitivo
  • PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Auxílio creche e Auxílio parentalidade atípica
  • Wellhub
  • Auxílio home office
  • QuintoCare: Nosso programa de apoio (saúde mental, assistência social, apoio jurídico e financeiro)
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Dia livre de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais
  • Clube de Benefícios (descontos em serviços do dia a dia)
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino
  • Kit leiturinha para crianças - Playkids

Diversidade & Inclusão

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei n° 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato pelo Canal de Atendimento.

title: [Martech] Product Designer II
description:
Como é ser uma pessoa Product Designer:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é servir Canais Digitais, Marketing e Growth com tecnologia para alavancar o crescimento e a eficiência do funil de vendas. Somos um time de tecnologia responsável pelos sites das marcas do grupo (Stone, Ton e Pagar.me) — cuidando de CMS, infraestrutura e evolução contínua — e pelas ferramentas que suportam marketing e vendas, como Salesforce e Marketcloud. Trabalhamos para criar experiências digitais escaláveis, integradas e alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer, com foco em criação de interfaces e experiências digitais para plataformas web.
  • Capacidade de conduzir todo o processo de design, desde a pesquisa com usuários até a entrega de wireframes, protótipos e especificações.
  • Conhecimento em design systems e ferramentas como Figma, FigJam, entre outras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa, comunicando-se com as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e marketing para garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades do usuário e aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e entrega interativa.
  • Habilidade para conduzir testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento de usuários, garantindo que os designs sejam orientados por dados e feedback real.
  • Foco constante na experiência do usuário, sempre buscando simplificar e otimizar o design.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs ou no mercado financeiro.
  • Habilidade em design de interfaces para sistemas complexos e de grande escala.
  • Experiência com metodologias como Design Thinking e Lean UX.
  • Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar e defender as escolhas de design de forma clara e impactante.
  • Desejo de se atualizar constantemente sobre novas tendências e práticas no design de produtos.

Benefícios: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)

Horário flexível

Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento

Auxílio Creche

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

description:
Overview

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and execution of QA strategies across projects within Tether Data.
  • Define and implement test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align testing with development and release processes.
  • Evaluate feature proposals, ensuring that they are well defined and verifiable.

title: Account Manager - HOMES/HEAR Program
description:
Overview

APTIM's Energy Transition is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager . This position is based in Minnesota and serves as a primary conduit to the market providing education and collaboration to stakeholders on behalf of the HOMES/HEAR program. APTIM's role is to develop and manage Home Energy Rebates created through the Inflation Reduction Act including the Home Efficiency Rebate Program (HOMES) and the Home Electrification and Appliance Rebate Program (HEAR). The Sr. Account Manager will be responsible for networking with customers and stakeholders to drive program performance and goal attainment. Residential program knowledge and technical expertise in energy efficiency and electrification is required. This role will report to the Program Manager.

APTIM's Energy Transition team is a recognized leader in the marketplace. Our technical experts deliver highly innovative projects and complex client solutions providing the full breadth of energy solutions including energy management, carbon management, smart energy infrastructure, distributed energy resources (DER), and carbon-free mobility solutions. Our consultants proactively collaborate with clients to define and implement strategies and campaigns around key business drivers, with the primary focus of finding and delivering high-impact projects exceeding expectations and meeting the unique needs for our clients.

The successful candidate will immediately assume an active role supporting the planning and operational activities for the programs. The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for utilizing existing community partners and building a network of stakeholders and customers targeting energy efficiency projects that align with the HOMES/HEAR program. The Sr. Account Manager will be expected to engage with organizations proactively to understand their unique goals and challenges and communicate how the HOMES/HEAR programs can support those goals and challenges. This position will be a critical member of the team by informing overarching strategic direction and driving new initiatives and energy savings.

This position is based in Minnesota and will have frequent day travel within specific territories. There is the opportunity for travel outside of the area, sporadically, for conferences, events, and continuing education. The Sr. Account Manager must be a critical thinker, able to manage multiple tasks, have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to maintain positive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners. The role requires a person who is accountable, process driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic. Individuals in this role will be expected to embrace a collaborative approach, take ownership of their workspace, and find solutions to challenges as they arise and be highly flexible to adjust to program needs. In this role, you will be working with others who are passionate about clean energy, energy efficiency, and making a positive impact on the industry.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Work as part of an energy efficiency and electrification team ensuring the administration, implementation, and verification of federally funded energy efficiency projects are successfully executed.
  • Develop reporting that aligns with DOE requirements and provides operations leadership insights to improve operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing or potential organizations to produce qualified leads, layer services/rebates and/or improve the customer experience, driving project participation.
  • Connect regularly with organizations via phone, email, virtual platforms, and face-to-face discussions to ensure they are current on HOMES/HEAR offerings and efforts, and to gain the organizations perspective on issues relating to the programs.
  • Lead and project manage initiatives that drive toward improved customer experience and participation in programs.
  • Develop and lead presentations promoting HOMES/HEAR programs at various conferences, community events, or professional organizations.
  • Respond to direct inquiries and requests made by customers, organizations, and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Deliver supporting information, collateral, and contacts to partners to support deepened customer engagement.
  • Be attuned to broad regulator, policy, and economic concerns impacting programs and bring these perspectives to program leadership.
  • Perform field QAQC as needed within assigned territory.
  • Frequent day travel and occasional overnight (depending on conferences, training or other opportunities).
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Ensuring compliance with all APTIM quality and safety policies as well as all OSHA regulations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of industry experience required.
  • Knowledge of energy efficiency and electrification programs.
  • Experience working with any of the following stakeholders: businesses, contractors, utilities, CBOs, community leaders, retailers, program implementers, manufacturers or distributors of energy-efficient equipment or services.
  • Strong service orientation with the ability to work across multiple departments and units within an organization, external clients, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management, project management, and follow-through; creative problem solver with strong analytical abilities.
  • Ability to absorb information from multiple parties and formulate necessary communications or decisions quickly.
  • Conceptual understanding of energy efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, and the types of equipment, technologies, and building practices relevant to residential customers.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience in the use of typical productivity software tools.
  • Strong quantitative and analytic capabilities to interpret data and solve practical problems.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills.
  • Ability to travel within Minnesota regularly and occasionally out-of-state.
  • Must be a self-starter, organized and have an ability to manage competing priorities with established deadlines.
  • Commitment to fostering a collaborative work environment within the team and broader organization.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office software -- Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.

Desired/Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience working with a wide variety of stakeholders, such as state, local and federal governments, for-profit and non-profit organizations, utilities, multifamily properties and others.
  • CEM, BPI, QCI, PMP, or similar certification.
  • 3+ years' experience in the energy efficiency industry.

About APTIM

APTIM is committed to accelerating the transition toward a clean and efficient energy economy, building a sustainable future for our communities and natural world, and creating a more inclusive and equitable environment that celebrates the diversity of our communities. We specialize in environmental, resilience, and sustainability and energy solutions, as well as technical and data solutions, program management, and critical infrastructure. For every challenge our clients face, there is an opportunity for APTIM to innovate a fit-for-purpose solution that will raise your organization or community to a new standard of excellence.

What you can expect from APTIM:

  • Work that is worthy of your time and talent
  • Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
  • Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
  • A voice in making our company better
  • Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $90K-$140K. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

Employee Benefits

Aptim Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits Marketplace information is available internally.

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and 10+ carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here.

description:
The impact you will have:

  • Accurate and reliable commissions : Ensure commission processes are managed with precision, supporting timely and error-free payouts that build trust across the sales organization.
  • Clear visibility into revenue operations : Strengthen reporting and data integrity in Spiff, Salesforce, and billing systems, enabling leadership to make confident, data-driven decisions.
  • Proactive issue resolution : Help surface and address discrepancies in opportunities, contracts, or commission data early, minimizing downstream risks and delays.
  • Scalable processes and automation : Contribute to the design of workflows and reporting that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, and adapt as the business grows.
  • Cross-functional alignment : Build strong relationships with Sales, Finance, and Operations by serving as a reliable partner and trusted resource on commissions and revenue reporting.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, commissions administration, or related finance roles, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency with commissions tools (Spiff preferred), Salesforce CRM, and billing/AR platforms, with the ability to implement changes and troubleshoot independently.
  • Background in accounting operations (billing, invoicing, AR, or contract review) that strengthens commission accuracy and revenue reporting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent projects without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reconciliations, variance analysis, and supporting ASC 340-40 compliance.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who provides fast, reliable support to cross-functional stakeholders.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description—we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and engineers in 2016, Pismo is a technology company that provides a comprehensive processing platform for banking, card issuing and financial market infrastructure and helps customers innovate and build the next generation of banking and payment solutions. Pismo’s cloud-based platform empowers firms to build and launch financial products rapidly, scaling as they grow to have a broader audience while keeping high security and availability standards.

Pismo’s 500+ employees are located in more than 10 countries around the world.

Desirable:

title: FX Trader - EMEA
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We seek an experienced and dynamic FX Sales Manager to drive business growth and manage relationships with key clients in the money remittance and financial services sectors. In this role, you will lead FX negotiations, collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions and ensure exceptional execution of cross-border payment transactions. You will leverage your expertise in FX markets to provide valuable insights to clients while consistently meeting sales targets and contributing to the organization’s overall success.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive negotiations with existing money remittance and financial services merchants, ensuring the achievement of sales targets while optimizing client value.
  • Build and maintain long-lasting relationships with clients by understanding their specific needs and delivering tailored FX solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Work closely with the internal Trader team to ensure alignment on market strategies, competitive pricing, and efficient execution of FX transactions.
  • Provide clients with actionable insights on FX market trends, movements, and forecasts, helping them stay informed and make sound decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of FX transactions, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and operational excellence.
  • Regularly conduct market analysis and research on industry trends and competitors to stay ahead of market developments and anticipate client needs.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What skills do I need?

  • Strong knowledge of local and international FX markets, including market dynamics, trading strategies, and regulatory environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets, with a track record of driving revenue growth and expanding business opportunities.
  • Exceptional business development, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with experience managing high-value client accounts.
  • In-depth understanding or experience with cross-border payment systems and their complexities, including risk management and cost optimization.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a logical problem-solving approach, helping identify opportunities and overcome challenges.
  • Highly self-motivated and goal-driven, with the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.

title: Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

We are a leader in fraud prevention and AML compliance. Our platform uses device intelligence, behavior biometrics, machine learning, and AI to stop fraud before it happens. Today, over 300 banks, retailers, and fintechs worldwide use Sardine to stop identity fraud, payment fraud, account takeovers, and social engineering scams. We have raised $145M from world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Activant, Visa, Experian, FIS, and Google Ventures.

Our Culture

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn\'t have to miss your family dinner, your kid\'s school play, friends get-together, or doctor\'s appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location: Remote - Brazil

To be considered for this position, you must reside in one of the following cities:

  • São Paulo: São Paulo, Campinas, São José dos Campos
  • Rio de Janeiro: Rio de Janeiro
  • Minas Gerais: Belo Horizonte
  • Paraná: Curitiba
  • Santa Catarina: Florianópolis

About The Role

We\'re a growing company looking for a Product Designer to join our team and help us design a user-centric SaaS dashboard to prevent fraud.

This isn\'t just about pixels; it\'s about problem-solving. You\'ll work closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to understand complex challenges and create intuitive and comprehensive experiences for our users. We have a complex product; you will need to make it easy.

As a fast-growing start-up, you will need to independently explore the context, talk to different stakeholders, understand the problem end-to-end, and propose solutions that make sense with our product.

Requests usually come with just the tip of the iceberg. You will need to get into the bushes. This role is not for a Product Designer that expects a complete brief, a list of detailed tasks, and endless calls. We move fast. You need to be fast. And good.

What You\'ll Do

  • Proactively drive the entire design process, from independently identifying user problems and exploring solutions through research and validation, to final implementation and hand-off.
  • Go beyond the \"happy path\" by designing for all user flows, edge cases, and UI states to ensure a smooth hand-off to engineering.
  • We are remote, you need to show visibility, communicate status, and progress reports with your team. Comment, annotate, and tag teammates in all your files. Work closely with product managers and engineers.

What You\'ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience (or strong portfolio) designing UI and UX for dashboards and SaaS products.
  • Master Figma, with expertise in Auto Layout, Components, Variants, and Prototypes
  • Master Design Systems and their application to create and scale a consistent dashboard experience
  • User-centered design principles with a strong understanding of data visualization best practices
  • Experience communicating with leadership. You will communicate ideas and ping pong requirements with the CEO, CTO, and CPO levels.
  • Be aware of the future state of design. AI is changing the game. We are already exploring new design workflows.
  • Startup / Small Company / Founder Experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in globally distributed teams
  • If you\'ve worked in Fraud, AML, Compliance, Payments, Fintech, Banking, that\'s a plus
  • Played around with Figma Make, Gemini, Loveable, v0, or similar? Sweet!
  • A little front-end code familiarity will make your job easier

Compensation

Base pay range of R$265,000- R$370,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

The compensation offered for this role will depend on various factors, including the candidate\'s location, qualifications, work history, and interview performance, and may differ from the stated range.

Benefits We Offer

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity
  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested
  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture
  • Flexible paid time off, Year-end break, Self care days off
  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific
  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific
  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door
  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.
  • Monthly meal stipend
  • Monthly social meet-up stipend
  • Annual health and wellness stipend
  • Annual Learning stipend
  • Unlimited access to an expert financial advisory

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

title: Partnership Sales Lead
description:
Partnership Sales Manager.

IWG – Partnership Sales Lead

Are you ready to lead the charge and be at the forefront of our ambitious global expansion? Is hunting, pitching and prospecting second nature to you? Can you confidently agree high-value commercial deals with building owners? Is business development in your blood? And are you relentless in your pursuit of delivering results, with the determination and resilience to change the world of work?

If yes, we need to talk.

What we can do for you

You’re reading the right ad if you’re looking for:

  • The most exciting growth opportunity in the world, where you’ll be challenged every day
  • Excellent training, development and promotion opportunities
  • A fantastic incentive scheme which can see you earn great commission and prizes.

We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. It’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres. And it’s what made IWG the dominant global leader in the flexible-workspace industry.

About IWG

IWG is the world’s leading flexible workspace provider – with the world’s most ambitious growth programme to open 30,000+ new centres over the next decade to complement our international network of 4,000+ tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring flexible work centres. Across our multiple brands, including Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, we’re provide world-beating workplace solutions to over 80% of Fortune 500 companies, including Netflix, EY, Amazon and Uber, as well as to local small start-ups, entrepreneurs and emerging businesses.

About you

You’ll need to be passionate about working in a high-growth sector and ready to play a leading role in disrupting the commercial real-estate industry. You’ll excel at growing your network rapidly and taking our proposition to them. And you’ll thrive on initiating and closing multiple high-value deals at pace driven by your tenacity and expertise.

Whether pursuing your own leads or following up on centrally-driven enquiries, you’ll highlight what makes an IWG partnership so special. By ensuring prospective partners fully understand the value of our proposition, you’ll be doing much more than simply meeting sales targets. And thanks to your outstanding communications skills – primarily in your local language but also with a good level of English – you’ll be able to present a truly compelling narrative to large and small audiences alike.

Most importantly though, you’ll have the right, can-do mindset: passion, curiosity, pride, drive and ownership. We’ll look after the rest.

What you’ll be doing

Join our team of over 200 Partnerships Sales Leaders and you’ll get to harness your entrepreneurial mindset, strong business and financial acumen, and commitment to achieving outstanding business development results as we add to the over 1,000 deals in 50+ countries closed in the past year alone.

From one day to the next, you’ll get the chance to:

  • Agree high-value deals to deliver inspiring new partner locations, leveraging your expertise to expand the IWG network in every town and city
  • Hunt out exciting opportunities in commercial buildings of all types across your region, pitch for new partnership opportunities, convince partners to invest anywhere from £250k to £1m+ to develop a new IWG branded centre and close out deals quickly & effectively
  • Showcase the value of the IWG partnership proposition to your network of B2B connections
  • Source ambitious partners who match our growth goals and can help drive our rapid growth through building conversions, new development locations or competitor conversions
  • Employ a dynamic and versatile approach to business development, tailoring it to our partners’ varying commercial needs and requirements
  • Actively manage your pipeline of opportunities to drive each opportunity from initial contact, through detailed commercial negotiations, all the way to a signed commercial agreement.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose is to help everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet. We are proud to supply all our customers with carbon-neutral workplaces, and have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award

IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023 and 2024. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
